Call for Expressions of Interest: Hosting a GEN-IMPACT Sub-study within APCC Cohorts

Deadline:
Friday, August 14, 2026

Submission Deadline: 14 August 2026, 1800HRS, East African Time (EAT)

The REOI is the first stage in a broader process and may invite selected applicants to submit a full application.

The call is intended to identify African-led research teams and consortia collaborating with APCC cohorts.
